10:26.text: For them who have done good is the best
No darkness will cover their faces, nor humiliation. Those are companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

10:27.text: evil doings - the recompense of an evil deed is its equivalent, and humiliation will cover them. They will have from Allāh no protector. It will be as if their faces are covered with pieces of the night - so dark
. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

10:28.text: , the Day We will gather them all together - then We will say to those who associated others with Allāh, "
and their "partners" will say, "You did not used to worship us,

10:29.text: And sufficient is Allāh as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware."

10:30.text: , every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously, and they will be returned to Allāh, their master, the Truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent.

10:31.text: Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Or who controls hearing and sight and who brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and who arranges
matter?" They will say, "Allāh," so say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

10:32.text: For that is Allāh, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted?

10:33.text: of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe.
